levels.R0: analytic limits/controlled interiors; R0_extension explicit finite-field physics evidence
levels.RN: PBC same-N sector ED and named continuous response peaks
levels.Rlarge: separate multi-size evidence, appended after MPS; never copies labels to N8

grid_weight: Tensor product Voronoi cell widths on each stated rectangular domain; never pool refined point counts for an area fraction
peak_rule: Largest non-endpoint peak of the SAME named observable; ambiguous if another peak >=90% and separated >.075. No nearest-reference peak pairing.
warning: Single kappa>.5 peak is not split into two transitions; endpoints retained as unresolved. C/SF redundancy explicitly removed for new feature distance.
